_about: The credits: what the game's Credits page shows and tools/release/gen_notices.py writes into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. `what` and the titles are English message ids (locale/player.tr.po). Say what was used and under which terms; a right that could not be checked is not claimed here (see ../ASSET_CREDITS.md).
ai_notice: Much of this game was made with AI tools: most of its icons, 3D models, visual effects, sound, music and program code began as AI output, and were then chosen, edited and put together by its developer. The tools are listed below.

entries.name: Godot Engine
entries.by: © 2014-present Godot Engine contributors, © 2007-2014 Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur
entries.what: Game engine. Its licence and third-party notices are in the full licence texts.

entries.name: Terrain3D
entries.by: © 2023-2026 Cory Petkovsek, Roope Palmroos, and Contributors
entries.what: The terrain of the outdoor maps.

entries.name: godot-cpp
entries.what: Built into the Terrain3D library.

entries.name: godot-rust
entries.what: The bridge between the game's Rust code and the engine. The other Rust libraries are listed below.

entries.name: Human Shaders
entries.what: Skin pore and iris textures (CC BY 4.0, unchanged); the skin lighting follows its skin shader (MIT).

entries.name: Literata
entries.what: Interface lettering. Its licence is in the full licence texts.

entries.name: NVIDIA SimReady Assets
entries.what: Food, plates and kitchenware on the castle's tables. Changed: decimated, normal maps re-baked, textures packed into one atlas, arranged into table settings.

entries.name: Quaternius
entries.what: Modular Character Outfits, Universal Base Characters and the Universal Animation Library: the hero's body, clothes and many animations.

entries.name: MakeHuman
entries.by: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier (via MPFB)
entries.what: The hero's head, face shapes, skin, eyes, eyelashes and eyebrows.

entries.name: KayKit
entries.what: Adventurer characters, dungeon pieces and props.

entries.name: Poly Haven
entries.what: Stone, wood, roof and plaster textures, trees, plants and rocks.

entries.name: ambientCG (CC0 Textures)
entries.what: Ground, rock, sand and gravel textures of the terrain.

entries.name: Particle Pack
entries.what: Flame and spark sprites.

entries.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle
entries.what: Recorded sound effects.

entries.name: Stable Audio
entries.what: AI-generated sound effects and music.

entries.name: ElevenLabs
entries.what: AI-generated sound effects and music.

entries.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D, Meshy
entries.what: AI-generated 3D models of characters, creatures, items and props, and creature rigs.

entries.name: OpenAI image models, Google Nano Banana, ByteDance Seedream
entries.what: AI-generated icons, portraits, crests, concept images and textures.

entries.name: Alibaba Wan
entries.what: AI-generated clips behind the spell effects.

entries.name: Tencent Hunyuan Motion
entries.what: AI-generated spell-casting motion.

entries.name: Anthropic Claude and other coding assistants
entries.what: Much of the game's program code, tools and text.

entries.name: Blender
entries.what: Modelling, rigging and baking.

entries.name: Mixamo
entries.what: Walking, running and jumping animations.
